input.summary: Add Array IP-infringement indemnity limb to Section 16.2 and carve IP claims out of Ono's Section 16.1(a) indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] Array's indemnity in Section 16.2 covers only Array Territory activities, Array-sponsored studies and Article 15 breaches, so no party stands behind third-party IP infringement claims arising from our exercise of the licensed Array Patents and Know-How (and Section 15.4 disclaims any non-infringement warranty), while our Section 16.1(a) indemnity captures every Third Party Claim from our Ono Territory activities, including such IP claims. We have added an IP infringement limb to Array's indemnity and a matching carve-out from ours; we can discuss the usual exclusions (our modifications or combinations) or a cap on this limb as a fallback.

ops.oldText: and (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, except to the extent
ops.newText: (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, and (e) notwithstanding Section 11.4, any Third Party Claim alleging that Ono's exercise of the licenses granted by Array hereunder, or the Development, Manufacture, use, importation or Commercialization of any Product in the Ono Territory in accordance with this Agreement, infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right of a Third Party, except to the extent

ops.oldText: including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom;
ops.newText: including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, but excluding any Third Party Claim alleging that the Development, Manufacture, use, importation or Commercialization of any Product infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right of a Third Party;
